task: Eliminate spurious 'timed out waiting for metadata lock' failures under heavy parallel load by migrating the three hand-rolled 5s metadata-lock loops to the shared 30s withMkdirLock primitive, then retire the B-348d retryOnAnyFailure stopgap flags once proven unnecessary.
outcome: Running `npm run test:all` on a heavily loaded machine no longer produces 'review_pass_set: timed out waiting for metadata lock' (or the review_run_start / init_check_set equivalents); the four smokes field-regression-cli, verification-freshness, worktree-repair, review-pass-discard pass under heavy parallel load even with `--no-retry`. `grep -c 'Date.now() + 5000' across the three handlers returns 0, and `grep -c retryOnAnyFailure packages/main/smoke-manifest.json` returns 0. Build is clean.
facts: finding.ts withReviewPassLock, review-run.ts withReviewRunLock, init-check.ts withInitCheckLock each hand-roll a mkdir lock loop with deadline=Date.now()+5000, 50ms poll, 10s stale-reclaim, and run autoCommitStoryMetadata (git commit) inside the critical section.

core/mkdir-lock.ts withMkdirLock (a REUSED dependency, not modified by this story) already provides the same atomic-mkdir lock with DEFAULT_DEADLINE_MS=30000, DEFAULT_STALE_MS=10000, and a documented invariant that deadline must exceed staleMs so a crashed holder's lock is reclaimable.
checklist.ts withChecklistLock already delegates to withMkdirLock (B-6812: the checklist-lock extraction story); the shared helper was extracted from the old checklist lock for reuse.

Reproduced failure: 20 concurrent smoke processes -> field-regression-cli FAILed 2/24 with 'review_pass_set exited 1: timed out waiting for metadata lock (EEXIST mkdir review-passes.lock)'. The test assertReviewPassConcurrentCliSurface fires 5 concurrent review_run_start + 5 concurrent review_pass_set on one story.
Verified the fix direction: with the budget bumped 5s->30s, 8 concurrent field-regression-cli + 8 filler smokes produced 0/8 failures.
No test or production code asserts on the literal 'timed out waiting for metadata lock' string outside the three handlers themselves, so changing the timeout message wording is safe.
constraints: All code changes go through this Lattice story (audit trail); artifacts in English.
Modify only the 6 allowed paths; reuse withMkdirLock unchanged; B-3d39 main-write-lock and B-2941 run-all-smokes runner stay frozen.
The git commit must stay inside the lock critical section (correct per-story commit serialization).
Lock paths (storyFilePath(storyId,'<x>.lock')) and external command semantics must not change.
Removing a retryOnAnyFailure flag is gated on empirical proof (heavy --no-retry stress, 0 FAIL); keep a flag for any smoke that still fails.
unknowns: Whether all four B-348d-flagged smokes pass under heavy --no-retry stress after the lock fix, or whether one has a residual sub-cause that warrants keeping its flag (resolved empirically in CHK-002).
